item.title: Could Einstein’s equations explain the universe’s expansion?
item.description: Researchers from UC Davis have proposed that dark energy may not be necessary to explain the universe's acceleration. They found weak points in the Lambda-cold dark matter model using Einstein's equations. By examining instabilities in Friedmann spacetimes, they suggest alternative explanations for cosmic expansion. Their work raises questions about the Copernican principle in the context of current models. This research could lead to significant shifts in our understanding of cosmology. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Scientists have developed a new technology that could make electric car batteries smaller, lighter and longer-lasting, potentially letting drivers travel farther on a single charge without carrying a heavier battery
item.description: Scientists from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology developed a new technology for anode-free batteries. item.title: Collective human metabolism produces 2 billion metric tons of CO₂ a year, global study estimates

item.description: A 12th-century Manjushri sculpture from Nepal recently sold for around ₹166 crore, illuminating the exceptional artistry of Newar creators from the Kathmandu Valley.
